PZ770 Miniature Pressure Sensor

Engineered and manufactured by PMC-STS  |  Release 10.80.0652.A — 2026.03

What is this AID AI Datasheet™?

This AID AI Datasheet™ is an interactive engineering companion to the official STS PZ770 PDF datasheet — running entirely in your browser, no login, no installation required. All specifications are sourced directly from the published PMC-STS datasheet (Release 10.80.0652.A). The PDF datasheet remains the authoritative contractual document.

01

Select Pressure Range

Use the Pressure Explorer to find the right range (15–6000 psi) and view all accuracy and error band data instantly.

02

Check Accuracy vs. Temperature

Visualize published total error band across all temperature windows for all six pressure ranges. Values shown are from the manufacturer’s datasheet.

03

Verify Safety Margins

Enter your operating pressure to compute engineering estimates of proof and burst safety margins, derived from the manufacturer’s published ratings.

04

Choose Output Interface

Compare 4–20 mA, 0.5–4.5 V, and mV/V outputs side-by-side with full wiring tables.

05

Explore Process Connections

Select from 11 process connection options and view the corresponding dimension drawing.

06

Generate Ordering Code

Use the Smart Configurator to build a valid PZ770 ordering code from your selections.

07

Check Weight Budget

Calculate total installed sensor mass for aerospace weight budget planning.

08

Ask the AI Assistant

Get instant answers to application, specification, or configuration questions from the embedded AI.

Output Interface Selector

Click a card to compare output options in detail.

4–20 mA

Current Loop

Industry-standard 2-wire current loop for industrial and aerospace long-cable applications.

✓ Immune to cable resistance & EMI
✓ 575 Hz sampling rate
⚠ Requires 9–40 VDC supply
0.5–4.5 V

Voltage Output

3-wire voltage output for direct ADC interface in data acquisition systems.

✓ Easy ADC interface, >10 kΩ load
✓ 7–36 VDC supply range
⚠ Supply influence: 0.3%
mV/V

Ratiometric Bridge

4-wire Wheatstone bridge — lowest power, ratiometric for lab and test applications.

✓ Ratiometric — supply noise cancels
✓ 1–10 VDC supply
⚠ Requires instrumentation amplifier
